headline: Review of the 2026-27 policy update plan and the C10 policy on responding to harassment, hazing, and bullying of students.
summary: The meeting includes public comment. It will also discuss which policies to update or review and which old policies to sunset.

Review C10 Response to Harassment, Hazing and Bullying of Students
location: Champlain Elementary School - Library 800 Pine Street
plain_text:
BSD Policy & Governance Committee Meeting Agenda 
Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 6:00 PM 
Champlain Elementary School - Library 800 Pine Street 
 
 
1. Opening   
1.1 Call meeting to order  
1.2 Suspend Robert's Rules  
2. Public Comment   
3. Discussion   
3.1 Review plan of work for 26-27: policies to update/review and old policies to sunset  
3.2 Review C10 Response to Harassment, Hazing and Bullying of Students  
4. Adjournment  
Burlington School District Contact 864-8474 for questions on this agenda. This agenda is available in 
alternative formats upon request. Persons with disabilities, who require assistance or special arrangements 
to participate in programs and activities of the Burlington School Board of Commissioners, are encouraged 
to contact us at 802-864-8474 (voice) or 711 (TTY) at least 72 hours in advance so that proper arrangements
